name: model-routing
description: Route Codex work to the least costly model likely to complete it correctly, with evidence-based escalation and native worker delegation.

interface.shortDescription: Choose a model by task risk and complexity.
interface.longDescription: Provides a portable Codex routing policy, Luna/Sol/Astra worker profiles, and one-command install and uninstall scripts.
defaultPrompt: Apply the model-routing policy to this task and delegate to the appropriate native worker when required.
